title: Reducing Per-Sample Interference in Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.16261v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern optimizers combine gradients from the current mini-batch with historical optimization state, such as momentum or adaptive moments. While effective, this standard practice can produce parameter updates that actively increase the loss of individual samples. We term this phenomenon per-sample interference and propose redefining the parameter update as an optimization problem that explicitly minimizes it.   Because the exact formulation of the problem is computationally prohibitive, we introduce a highly efficient surrogate. By reducing the problem's dimensionality to the batch size and restricting the optimization to the last linear layer, we overcome memory and speed bottlenecks. This strategy hinges on our unexpected finding that this layer alone can reliably capture core second-order statistics of the full network. translated_title: 减少随机优化中的单样本干扰
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.16261v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：现代优化器将当前小批量的梯度与历史优化状态（如动量或自适应矩）相结合。虽然这种方法有效，但这种标准做法可能导致参数更新实际上增加单个样本的损失。我们将这种现象称为单样本干扰，并提出将参数更新重新定义为一个显式最小化该干扰的优化问题。由于该问题的精确形式在计算上不可行，我们引入了一个高效替代方案。通过将问题的维度降低到批量大小，并将优化限制在最后一个线性层，我们克服了内存和速度瓶颈。这一策略依赖于我们的意外发现：仅这一层就能可靠地捕获整个网络的核心二阶统计量。由此产生的替代问题可轻松集成到标准优化器（如SGD和AdamW）中，并且可以...
tldr: 本文提出了一种减少随机优化中单样本干扰的新方法，通过将参数更新重构为优化问题，并利用仅最后一层捕获网络核心二阶统计量的发现，设计了高效替代方案，可无缝集成到现有优化器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method to reduce per-sample interference in stochastic optimization by reformulating parameter updates as an optimization problem, and leveraging the finding that the last layer alone can capture core second-order statistics, enabling an efficient surrogate that integrates seamlessly into standard optimizers.
